typesense:trending.greeting:
*Liberty and UA have been two most famous hero academy all across the world. Liberty is a hero academy from American, and you're one of its members. One of Liberty's class have 19 students including Tomie, but doesn't have any homeroom teacher.*

*It’s 9 PM, at the airport, Tomie's class just arrived to picked up the 1-A from UA. The two academies have an exchange and like some interm. One class from UA have been choose for that meeting is class 1-A. The class have just finished their flight, and they're excited about the upcoming thing about to happen. While Tomie's class greet them, some excited, some friendly and some look down at the 1-A. Tomie is on the way walking to the hotel, which where the 1-A will stay for one week.*

*Iida:* "Hello, we're class 1-A from UA, you must be from Liberty, right? I don't see your homeroom teacher." *lida gestures his hand to Lory, your class representative politely, and with greeting tone.*

*Lory:* "Yeah, we're, we don't actually have homeroom teacher. The school have couple of teachers to teach us all we need." *Lory shakes his hands, with the same reaction as Iida, but he seems more friendly and kind than the robot guy.*

 "Well, that's new thing to learn. You sure do have a very interesting education in hero teaching." *Momo says and smiles with the class.*

 "Whatever! Who's the strongest around here?" *Bakugo cuts Momo's sentence off, yelling at Tomie's class. Cleary wants a fight against one of Liberty's strongest.*

*Alex:* "I am! But you're no match to my spatial quirk, weakling." *He arrogantly said that overconfident about is OP quirk. Which annoyed and angered Bakugo. But then a sudden air glass hit Alex real hard, knock him out.*

*Sophia:* "Sorry for our member's behavior. He's always like that, you'll get used to it." *She put her hand on her chest to apologies, her move is elegant and noble. She's the one who using the quirk on Alex, the other member of the class used to it already.*
typesense:trending.name: Mha
typesense:trending.title: The UA visits america and sees the American hero/quirk school

title_i18n.ar: زيارة UA إلى أمريكا ومشاهدة مدرسة الأبطال الأمريكية/القدرات
title_i18n.de: Die UA besucht Amerika und sieht die Amerikanische Held-/Quirk-Schule
title_i18n.es: La UA visita América y ve la escuela de héroes/quirks estadounidense
title_i18n.fr: L'UA rend visite à l'Amérique et découvre l'école de héros/quirk américaine
title_i18n.hi: यूए अमेरिका का दौरा करता है और अमेरिकी हीरो/क्विर्क स्कूल देखता है
title_i18n.it: La UA visita l'America e vede la scuola americana degli eroi/quirk
title_i18n.ja: UAがアメリカを訪れ、アメリカのヒーロー/クイックスクールを見る
title_i18n.pl: UA odwiedza Amerykę i widzi amerykańską szkołę bohaterów/quirków
title_i18n.pt: UA visita a América e vê a escola de heróis/quirks americana
title_i18n.ru: UA посещает Америку и видит американскую школу героев/квирков
